title: One Bad Event Blocks a Partition
description: A malformed event fails on every attempt and blocks later records. The product allows isolating invalid events for repair while healthy work continues. Which policy makes that explicit?

options.explanation: A permanent failure will not heal through retries and can stall the partition indefinitely.

options.text: Add consumers beyond the partition count.
options.explanation: Extra group members cannot concurrently own the blocked partition and do not fix invalid input.

options.text: Delete the event silently and report normal processing.
options.explanation: That hides lost work and removes the information needed for repair.

options.text: Bound retries, preserve the event in an owned DLQ, alert and provide redrive.
options.explanation: A dead-letter path separates poison data from healthy progress under the stated contract. Ownership, diagnosis and safe redrive keep it from becoming silent data loss.
